from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document: its title, case type, and cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The document title as given")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Broad case category: civil, administrative, criminal, etc.")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific case cause/案由 described in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal document: judgment, ruling, notice, etc.")
    involves_administrative_revocation: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the case substantively involves administrative revocation/cancellation of rights")
    is_substantive_judgment: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this is a substantive judgment on the administrative act, not just a procedural ruling")
    quote: str = Field(description="Short excerpt from document that identifies the case type and cause")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
